title: OJT Organizer
description: A comprehensive OJT (On-the-Job Training) tracking application for monitoring student progress, managing training activities, and facilitating communication between trainees, supervisors, and coordinators.
features: Real-time student hour logging & supervisor approvals
Dynamic dashboard for coordinator analytics tracking
Interactive timesheet generation with certified export modes
Structured trainee onboarding and progress logging

guideSteps.title: Explore Blueprint
guideSteps.desc: Open the Figma link to examine interactive dashboard layouts, user flows, and wireframes.

guideSteps.title: Trainee Hours Logging
guideSteps.desc: Students input completed daily tasks, check-in timestamps, and request manager authorization.

guideSteps.title: Supervisor Approval
guideSteps.desc: Supervisors view instant requests to sign off on student logged hours and rate performance.

guideSteps.title: Analytics Dashboard
guideSteps.desc: Coordinators track BSU requirements progress, check overall status, and verify documents.

title: Jawibi App
description: Jawibi is an ordering system with admin and customer interfaces, primarily designed for admins to track sales and manage orders efficiently.
features: Intuitive customer ordering menu with customizable options
Real-time dashboard matching table notifications
Detailed admin panels tracking daily sales analytics
Instant thermal printer integration for order receipts

guideSteps.title: Application Launch
guideSteps.desc: Start the ordering system app on Android or iOS simulators via Expo Go client.

guideSteps.title: Menu Selection
guideSteps.desc: Select categories, choose custom side dishes, and add items into the active cart.

guideSteps.title: Table Checkout
guideSteps.desc: Confirm your table code, submit payments (Gcash/Cash), and request kitchen processing.

guideSteps.title: Kitchen Display
guideSteps.desc: Admims track incoming queues, update cook states, and process thermal printouts.

title: LibraLink • Figma
description: Library management system for Batangas State University - Lipa Campus featuring student access tracking and streamlined book borrowing.
features: Automated borrowing ledger and overdue book penalty trackers
QR-code student check-in access gateway
Comprehensive BSU library catalog inventory
Dynamic librarian dashboard for rapid book checkouts

guideSteps.title: Interactive Wireframe
guideSteps.desc: Access high-fidelity BSU library designs on Figma. Experience responsive layouts.

guideSteps.title: Access Logging
guideSteps.desc: Students scan QR entry tickets to register attendance instantly inside study areas.

guideSteps.title: Book Searching
guideSteps.desc: Look up available book volumes, check inventory states, and queue borrowing slips.

guideSteps.title: Librarian Checkin
guideSteps.desc: Confirm slips by scanning barcodes, log borrowing logs, and calculate return dates.

title: Responsys • Figma
description: An incident management system designed for the MDRRMO of Padre Garcia, enabling citizens to report emergencies and allowing responders to coordinate rapid response efforts in real-time.
features: One-tap emergency reporting with instant coordinate drop
Centralized dispatcher panel overlaying GPS incident maps
Drag-and-drop responder crew dispatch controls
Real-time event timelines and emergency radio telemetry logs

guideSteps.title: Crisis Report
guideSteps.desc: Citizens file reports, upload visual files, and drop geographic emergency pins.

guideSteps.title: Dispatcher Alarm
guideSteps.desc: The Padre Garcia command center rings and plots alerts on full-screen maps.

guideSteps.title: Unit Routing
guideSteps.desc: Dispatchers verify details and assign nearby MDRRMO units via drag-and-drop routing.

guideSteps.title: Responder Portal
guideSteps.desc: Crews receive dispatch coordinates and log updates from cellular devices.

title: Portfolio Website
description: Responsive personal portfolio site built with Tailwind CSS and vanilla Javascript. Highly optimized for speed, visual excellence, and SEO.
features: Super responsive layout that dynamically resizes for mobile to desktop
Vibrant premium dark/light mode toggle with state retention
Highly interactive custom micro-animations and glowing orbs
Fluid search & category filters for frictionless browsing

guideSteps.title: Local Cloning
guideSteps.desc: Clone the code using: git clone https://github.com/kingjrm/Portfolio.git

guideSteps.title: Library Install
guideSteps.desc: Run npm install inside the project directory to hook into Tailwind compilation dependencies.

guideSteps.title: Dev Watch
guideSteps.desc: Start automatic Tailwind updates tracking changes using: npm run dev

guideSteps.title: Production Build
guideSteps.desc: Compile lightweight assets for direct deployment using: npm run build

title: School Skill
description: A Learning Management System (LMS) designed to function like Google Classroom, providing tools for educators and students to collaborate, share resources, and manage coursework effectively.
features: Dynamic virtual class spaces with integrated access codes
Assignment deadllines tracking with calendar widgets
Flexible quizzes builder and student automatic grading curves
Interactive social feed supporting resource uploads

guideSteps.title: Classroom Access
guideSteps.desc: Students join teacher channels by keying in unique LMS security codes.

guideSteps.title: Resources Sharing
guideSteps.desc: Teachers write updates, post course materials, and trigger discussions.

guideSteps.title: Submitting Homework
guideSteps.desc: Students complete questionnaires, upload documents, and track deadlines.

guideSteps.title: Teacher Grading
guideSteps.desc: Teachers grade submissions, write feedback, and export scores spreadsheets.

title: My Thoughts
description: A beautifully designed diary system that empowers users to manage their thoughts and reflections day by day. Features an intuitive interface focused on daily journaling and personal growth.
features: Secure client-side diary entry encryption
Mood trackings with monthly visual correlation analytics
Flexible rich text diary builder with markdown tools
Warm premium theme presets adapting to reading comfort

guideSteps.title: New Reflections
guideSteps.desc: Initiate blank pages. Tag records with visual mood icons for statistics tracking.

guideSteps.title: Diary Formatting
guideSteps.desc: Apply blockquotes, highlights, bullet lists, or embed inline snapshots.

guideSteps.title: Correlations Plotting
guideSteps.desc: View monthly analytics illustrating mood histograms and word counters.

guideSteps.title: Encrypted Export
guideSteps.desc: Download entries as local encrypted files, ensuring complete reading privacy.

title: InventoryBox (Admin)
description: A robust inventory management system designed for administrators to efficiently track, organize, and manage all assets and inventory. Built with a focus on usability and streamlined workflows for admin users.
features: Live SKU tracker dashboards with instant low-stock indicators
Supplier ledger integrations and auto purchase drafts
Multi-location storage bins and allocations tracking
Batch printout utility for catalog QR codes

guideSteps.title: Asset Registry
guideSteps.desc: Populate details, set SKU prefixes, write tags, and input baseline counts.

guideSteps.title: Barcode Scanning
guideSteps.desc: Log stock items in/out instantly by scanning barcodes using connected cameras.

guideSteps.title: Purchase Order
guideSteps.desc: Draft restock requests, email suppliers, and track incoming shipments.

guideSteps.title: Inventory Count
guideSteps.desc: Export PDF sheets, execute physical inventory checks, and adjust balances.

title: Weather Application

Adaptive gradient layers matching regional times and seasons
7-day predictions visual charts showing humidity trends
Multi-city bookmarked dashboard cycling metric widgets

guideSteps.title: Credentials Hook
guideSteps.desc: Input OpenWeatherMap API credentials inside environment configuration variables.

guideSteps.title: Location Access

guideSteps.title: Detailed Analytics
guideSteps.desc: Expand info panels to verify wind indices, UV indicators, and air qualities.

guideSteps.title: Cycle Pinned Cities
guideSteps.desc: Swipe screens horizontally to inspect conditions in different target capitals.

features: Secure peer-to-peer textbook marketplace registry
Interactive escrow transaction and delivery trackers
Real-time P2P messaging with shipping quotes
Auto catalog recommendations via camera ISBN scans

guideSteps.title: Discover Books
guideSteps.desc: Filter books, find syllabi matches, and check regional textbook inventories.

guideSteps.title: Seller Negotiation
guideSteps.desc: Chat with students to negotiate book states and discuss delivery options.
